_about: What the approver's page shows for a Service / Tool / Method Document (G11). One file per form (user, 2026-10-07): change this file to change what the page shows - no code change. Read by IRSTasks through the `fields` key of the document subtype's entry in js/config/TaskFields.js (DOCUMENT_TYPES). Unlike the four task forms, the object here is a DOCUMENT: the G11 route approves the IRSServiceToolMethod Document itself (worklog 2026-10-19-12), and the page reads it through our REST JAR, `GET resources/v1/irsproject/documents/{id}/stm` (worklog 2026-10-19-14).
_generated: Written 2026-10-19 from the paper form R&D-STM Rev.00 (documents/as-is-markdown/.../1.R&D/Forms/R&D-STM.md), labels word for word, and from the same selects the signed PDF prints (mxupdate/custom/program/page/IRSSTMApprovalRouteConfig.json, pdf block), so the page and the PDF cannot disagree. Every value verified on 2026-002 with the JPO twin `exec program IRSStmDocumentContext`.

_source.project: the project the Document hangs under (`to[Reference Document].from`), as the JAR returns it: name, title, EPMProjectNo
_source.task: the DOCUMENT's own values, under the keys StmDocumentService puts in `attributes`: stmNumber, title, purposeAndApplication, sourceCode, installation
_source.derived: a list the service shaped: Involved Researcher(s), from relationship IRSSTMInvolvedResearcher
_source.none: not a value: the three signatures live in the route, drawn by the approval panel below the form

_notShown: Two things are deliberately absent (user, 2026-10-19): the CATEGORY (IRSSTMCategory - Service / Computational Tool / Method), which the paper form does not print either, and the top DATE, which is the day the Document reaches RELEASED and so has no value while the route is still running. The Date row is kept hidden rather than deleted, as on the other forms.
